provenance.prompt: Create one premium editorial illustration for a warm light technology explainer reel. A compact, beautifully organized developer toolkit: an open cream organizer case with exactly four distinct physical objects neatly fitted into compartments: a small orange architectural wireframe sculpture, a black precision cursor tool, a cream code-bracket shaped block, and a tidy orange cable loop. Communicate a clean uncluttered setup through disciplined arrangement and elegant negative space, not text. Three-quarter isometric perspective, tactile matte ceramic and softly polished metal, warm cream #f2efe8, ink black #1c1a16, vivid orange #ff6b1a only. Sophisticated high quality product illustration, strong readable silhouette, naturally grounded subtle contact shadows inside the object. No people, no brands, no logos, no letters, no numbers, no background surface, no scenery. Entire organizer and objects isolated on genuinely transparent alpha background, clean edges with no halo, all objects fully within frame. Square image composition, centered object occupies 80 percent.
